post_mortems.title: Post mortem for Harbour Relay 900 (payments dispute portal)
post_mortems.passage: Introduce a definition of ready guard before work enters delivery. Use progressive rollout controlled by flags for every release. Make the data protection officer an approver on transitions that change personal data handling. Treat security review as a workflow gate rather than an optional checklist item. Invite every business owner to a demo at least monthly.

post_mortems.title: Post mortem for Harbour Waypoint 900 (trade surveillance dashboard)
post_mortems.passage: Add a performance testing stage against forecast peak demand before release. Make the data protection officer an approver on transitions that change personal data handling. Make the rollback plan a mandatory field on the release transition. Add an independent security review state before release with a named security approver. Reduce WIP limits so the team finishes work before starting more.

methodology.title: Post Mortem Practice
methodology.section: Using post mortems for new projects
methodology.passage: Post Mortem Practice. Using post mortems for new projects. When a new charter arrives, the post mortems of the most similar historical projects are retrieved. Recommendations that recur across several similar projects carry more weight than a single mention, and their weight increases with the similarity of the source project.

methodology.title: Release and Deployment Controls
methodology.passage: Release and Deployment Controls. Performance testing. Services with high or spiky traffic need load and soak testing against forecast peak demand before release. Results are attached as a load test report to a performance testing gate.

triggers.description: Moves an item to code review when its pull request is opened.
Nudges reviewers when a review has waited longer than a working day.
Escalates blockers that have not cleared within two days.
Carries unfinished work into the next sprint and labels it.
Ramps exposure 1, 10, 50 then 100 percent with guardrail metrics.
Confirms the cardholder data environment boundary each quarter.
Checks personal data against retention rules.
